name: autoreach
description: AutoReach 2.0 — personal AI job-outreach workspace: recruiter CRM, opportunity tracker, AI-assisted Gmail outreach, reply detection and follow-ups.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @autoreach/backend && npm run build -w @autoreach/dashboard && npm run build -w @autoreach/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
